newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 969 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 969 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade's Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totaled 969 contracts, according to the CBOT.
There were 563 soybean, 322 corn, 24 wheat, 18 soymeal and nine soyoil futures traded, along with 22 soybean call, eight soybean put, two corn call and one wheat put option.
The overnight trend for corn was down 1-1/4 to three cents per bushel, soybeans up 1/2 to down 3-3/4, wheat down 1/2, soymeal down $0.90 a ton and soyoil down 0.08 cent a lb.
